about_the_game:
300 Levels. 25 Lives. Can You Survive?

Alien cats have arrived on Earth to capture their queen, but Cosmo the dog and Stella the cat won’t let them succeed! A deceptively challenging, vibrant puzzle game with a roguelike inspired element! Find all the invading alien cats hidden in the 6x6 grids—but be careful! Run out of lives, and you'll be sent back to the start. Every decision counts as you push through 300 days of increasing difficulty.

Features

  • Each level represents a day, and your goal is to survive all the way to Day 300. Don’t worry—your progress is saved as you complete each day, so you can take a break whenever you need to.  However, if you’ve used all your lives, your progress resets!

  • Levels are procedurally generated, ensuring the objects hidden in the 6x6 grid are different every time you play!

  • 16-bit style graphics with hand-drawn vibrant sprites, sprite scaling, particle and transparency effects!

  • Magical Yarn Balls - Use these items to get grid hints and manage them carefully as you go through the enemy waves.

  • Catchy soundtrack, classic style tunes with a modern synth-wave instrumentation.  You will be humming in no time!

  • No DLC or in-app purchases!  The only updates will be to improve the experience.

short_description: A roguelike inspired puzzle adventure where a loyal dog protects his cat from alien invaders! Search hidden grids, collect magic yarn balls, and survive 300 challenging levels with just 25 lives. Every move counts!
